findings.body: The previously reported cases remain broken: `6. There are no findings.`, `6. No bugs found.`, and `6. No findings reported.` The recognizer excludes their prefix, noun, or suffix, so each clean reply produces `passed: no` at src/forge/story.py:276 and requires a disposition and another round. This violates the Done-when requirement to accept common no-findings wording. The command table in tests/test_read_accepts_no_findings.py also still omits all three cases for both client histories. Extend recognition conservatively and add these cases to that table.
